evidence.decision: Chooses bounded frequently changing events over periodic widget data and designs lifecycle plus essential compact/minimal information first.
evidence.artifact: Requires event/update/alert/end and destination-presentation contract, including deep links and useful retained summary.
evidence.transformation: Courier example ends at delivery, redacts address and replaces control-dependent CarPlay behavior with useful noninteractive status.
evidence.verification: Checks multiple/minimal activity, completion/stale data, red/Always On and disabled controls; indefinite activity or duplicate alerts fails.
evidence.applicability: Qualifies Lock Screen-only background customization, shared Watch/CarPlay layouts, Mac iPhone Mirroring and TV/visionOS exclusion.
evidence.handoffs: Widgets, Notifications and App Shortcuts distinguish periodic content, separate alerts and useful initiation.
evidence.distinctiveness: Bounded event ending, dynamic destination expansion and driving-disabled actions are Live Activity-specific decisions.
